name: What does the trim installation process involve from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What does the trim installation process involve from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing trim requires a clear order of operations to ensure clean, tight joints. The process starts by measuring the room and carefully removing any old moldings without tearing the drywall paper. Next, finish carpenters locate wall studs, cut boards using precise miter and scarf joints, and fasten them with pneumatic nail guns. Once the boards are secured, the crew fills nail holes, caulks seams along wall junctions, and applies final coats of interior paint. Because HH Remodeling handles both finish carpentry and drywall/painting in-house, the transition from carpentry to paint finishing happens smoothly under single-crew management.
acceptedAnswer.description: The crew measures, removes old trim, nails new boards to wall studs with mitered joints, then fills nail holes, caulks seams, and applies smooth finish paint.
